findings.body: The TaskSequencer correctly handles the empty state when optimizedTasks is empty. It wraps a Typography element containing contextual messages with a ListItem component. Setting role="status" on the Typography rather than the ListItem preserves valid DOM list semantics since the parent List (ul) now only contains a child ListItem (li).
findings.title: Empty state implementation and semantic integrity
